name: sage-gate1-pre-decision
description: Fires a pre-decision Stoic examination via SageReasoning /api/reason BEFORE the agent — and each delegated subagent — reasons, then injects the examined frame deterministically (control-flow, not prompt guidance). UserPromptSubmit frames the top-level task; PreToolUse frames each subagent spawn. Fail-open with an honest log by default; configurable strict. Requires a SageReasoning practice credential set in the environment (SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL) — never bundled.
